# Third-party source and notices

This directory preserves selected upstream license texts, notices, and native build scripts with source/version identifiers and SHA-256 hashes in [`origins.json`](origins.json). The sharp-libvips files are copied verbatim from version 1.3.4 source revision [`ebb95f8add54eee8bed840e3fb587e4cbec857d7`](https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/tree/ebb95f8add54eee8bed840e3fb587e4cbec857d7). Its [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](sharp-libvips/1.3.4/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and native source recipes [`build/posix.sh`](sharp-libvips/1.3.4/build/posix.sh) and [`build/win.sh`](sharp-libvips/1.3.4/build/win.sh) are retained as provenance and rebuild references. The corresponding upstream packaging overview is the [`README.md` at that revision](https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/blob/ebb95f8add54eee8bed840e3fb587e4cbec857d7/README.md).

The standalone GNU GPL 3.0 and LGPL 3.0 text files are included verbatim. Go distribution, `github.com/gofrs/flock` 0.13.1, and `golang.org/x/sys` 0.47.0 license texts are also copied from the versions recorded in `origins.json`.

To rebuild devneya with changed native dependencies, rebuild or obtain the modified native package, pin that package artifact and its integrity in the source checkout's frozen npm manifests, then run `python3 scripts/build.py --target TARGET` on a native runner for that target with the pinned toolchain. The source builder installs the frozen npm tree and embeds it in the executable; it does not run the sharp-libvips native recipes itself. Consult the retained POSIX/Windows scripts and the pinned upstream packaging source when rebuilding native libraries. This directory records provenance and build references; it does not make a legal compliance determination.
